baseline.source_provenance_note: External identity/revision/URL are caller-declared; the executable matches the manifest SHA256. No external commit was fetched or verified, and no source-to-binary build relationship is proven.
baseline.configuration_note: validated_options records values accepted against advertised types/ranges after configure returned. UCI provides no general option readback; advertised defaults and sent settings are not independently verified engine state. python-chess manages Ponder/MultiPV/UCI_Chess960/UCI_Variant during play.

candidate.source_provenance_note: Commit is caller-declared and exists in this repository; the harness does not infer or prove the binary was built from it.

draw_policy_detail: Both players always claim an available threefold or 50-move draw, including an intended legal next move.

opening_selection: Ordered prefix fixed by invocation before results; both colors per opening.
pair_order: Each opening: candidate White, then candidate Black; openings in file order.
backtrack_definition: Adjacent engine-selected moves by the same side, both quiet non-pawn moves and neither a check evasion, form an opportunity. A->B then B->A by the same piece is a backtrack. Opening moves excluded. This is not a judgment that the reversal was unnecessary.
move_selection: Supplied binaries only; deterministic opening and color schedule; no runner move randomness.

summary.incomplete_scope: incomplete_games counts attempted unfinished games; unplayed_games counts scheduled games never started after an error.
summary.score_scope: Finite match score among completed games only; no Elo estimate.
summary.wilson_interpretation: Approximate descriptive Wilson interval with draws as half a success; independent Bernoulli assumptions do not hold for draws or paired openings and can overstate certainty.
